name: Daita Shouko
source:
Akihito’s classmate. Very strong for a girl and everyone seems to think she’s the gangster type. A pretty straightforward girl in terms of personality, which is why she’s misunderstood sometimes. Likes girly stuff and has a mischievous personality.
